# Scenario: every started container gets security_opt no-new-privileges:true
# and privileged forced false. README Privilege Escalation Protection.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: container hardening'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-harden-web

exec sh -c 'opts=$(docker inspect -f "{{json .HostConfig.SecurityOpt}}" $(docker ps -q --filter name=apinfra_e2e-harden-web)); echo "security_opt=$opts"; echo "$opts" | grep -q no-new-privileges'
exec sh -c 'priv=$(docker inspect -f "{{.HostConfig.Privileged}}" $(docker ps -q --filter name=apinfra_e2e-harden-web)); echo "privileged=$priv"; test "$priv" = "false"'

exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-harden/docker-compose.yml
grep 'no-new-privileges:true' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-harden/docker-compose.yml
! grep 'privileged: true' $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-harden/docker-compose.yml

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-harden
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9996
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-harden/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    privileged: true
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- .env --
